raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Score Sentence Transformers (v5.4+) CrossEncoders with the chat template they declare, so they work without `--chat-template`. 

This closes #60409, follow-up to #31563, and is complementary to #55359 (see Details).

## Claims

- A CrossEncoder whose single `sequence-classification` Transformer module declares the `message` modality in `sentence_bert_config.json` is now scored like in Sentence Transformers: `query`/`document` messages rendered with the saved chat template (the default one, or the named template from `processing_kwargs.chat_template.chat_template`).
- The other `processing_kwargs.chat_template` settings (e.g. `add_generation_prompt`) are passed to the template, like in Sentence Transformers; request `chat_template_kwargs` override them.
- `--chat-template` (or `LLM.score(chat_template=...)`) still takes precedence, and an invalid Sentence Transformers config then doesn't block startup. Checkpoints without this metadata, and models with a built-in score template (`SupportsScoreTemplate`), are unchanged.
- The template is resolved once at startup and logged. A declared template that the checkpoint doesn't have (including an unknown name) fails at startup, instead of silently falling back to pair encoding or to vLLM's fallback templates.

## Validation

- MTEB (NFCorpus, RTX 4080 SUPER): `nvidia/llama-nemotron-rerank-vl-1b-v2` without `--chat-template` scores 0.33922 (bf16) vs 0.33919 for Sentence Transformers 5.7.0 (fp32). Without this change: 0.30173, the test fails.
  `pytest tests/models/language/pooling_mteb_test/test_nemotron.py -k rerank`
- Online, with a tiny random Qwen3 CrossEncoder saved in the Sentence Transformers format: `vllm serve <tiny checkpoint> --runner pooling`, then `/rerank` and `/score` return the same scores as Sentence Transformers (0.51295, 0.519637), and `chat_template_kwargs: {"add_generation_prompt": false}` overrides the saved setting.
- Unit tests: `pytest tests/transformers_utils/test_config.py -k sentence_transformers tests/entrypoints/pooling/scoring/test_io_processor_unit.py tests/entrypoints/pooling/test_io_processor.py`
- `pre-commit run` passes.
- Real-world checkpoint with this layout: `nvidia/llama-nemotron-rerank-vl-1b-v2` (its `chat_template.jinja` was synced with vLLM in its commit "Share reranking chat template across Sentence Transformers and vLLM"). `test_reranker` in `tests/models/multimodal/pooling/test_llama_nemotron_vl.py` now runs without `chat_template` and still matches the HF reference on text and image documents (RTX 4080 SUPER, fp16). Without this change it fails (first text pair: HF 0.3191, vLLM 0.0575).
  `pytest tests/models/multimodal/pooling/test_llama_nemotron_vl.py -k test_reranker`
- On that model, the automatic path produces the same token IDs (BOS included) and scores as `--chat-template examples/pooling/score/template/nemotron-vl-rerank.jinja`.

## Details

- Detection is limited to the exact layout Sentence Transformers uses for sequence-classification CrossEncoders (`model_type: CrossEncoder`, one Transformer module at the root, `transformer_task: sequence-classification`, `message` in `modality_config`). Many rerankers inherit an unrelated chat template from their base LLM, so the tokenizer template is still never used without this explicit declaration, as discussed in #31563.
- The nemotron-rerank-vl reranker test and docs no longer pass `--chat-template` (separate commit).
- Message contents are passed as strings, like with `--chat-template`, so multimodal placeholders keep working.
- The templated prompt is tokenized as with `--chat-template` (default `add_special_tokens`). Plain transformers tokenizers render Sentence Transformers prompts with `add_special_tokens=False`, but custom processors may not: `nvidia/llama-nemotron-rerank-vl-1b-v2`'s processor tokenizes its prompts with the default and adds BOS. Keeping vLLM's existing behavior matches the only checkpoint with this layout I found (verified above); for Qwen3-based rerankers (no BOS) both are identical.
- `restore_suffix` (restoring the template suffix after truncation) is not implemented; the startup log and the docs say to use `max_tokens_per_doc` to truncate documents.
- The config is read in `CrossEncoderIOProcessor` rather than `ModelConfig`, since only scoring uses it and this avoids touching `ModelConfig` and its hash. If #55359 lands first, this can move next to its `sentence_transformers_config`.
- `LLM(chat_template=...)` is still not used by `LLM.score` (unchanged); the saved template applies there, and `LLM.score(chat_template=...)` overrides it.
- Relation to #55359: it handles the modular `Transformer -> Pooling -> Dense` and `Transformer -> LogitScore` layouts and leaves single-module checkpoints unchanged, so the two PRs do not overlap functionally. I kept the same module-type constant and setting names so they can be merged in either order; whichever lands second can reuse the other's helpers (e.g. its `restore_suffix` implementation).
- `nvidia/llama-nemotron-rerank-vl-1b-v2` revisions between its Sentence Transformers integration (April 2026) and b8a9987 (October 2026) declare the `message` modality but only ship the Llama 3 chat template inherited from the base model. Without `--chat-template`, those revisions were already scored without the right prompt; they still need the flag, as the docs now say.
- Motivation: `polaria-tech/zerank-2-reranker-vllm` (zerank-2 converted to `Qwen3ForSequenceClassification`, template added in #60415) can declare its score template this way instead of requiring `--chat-template`.

---

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

| `Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Reranker-{2B,8B}` | `Transformer` + `LogitScore`, named `reranker` template | Unchanged (LogitScore, #55359's scope) |

Unfortunately not, as far as I can tell, `nvidia/llama-nemotron-rerank-1b-v2` has no Sentence Transformers files on the Hub (no `modules.json`, `config_sentence_transformers.json` or `sentence_bert_config.json` at the current revision 8287656, nor in any of its PR refs), and its tokenizer has no chat template. Its model card still says the score template must be passed with `--chat-template`. It isn't in the v5.4 integrations collection either. Without `chat_template_name` it would fall back to plain text pairs and fail.

Maybe you were thinking of `nvidia/llama-nemotron-rerank-vl-1b-v2` (in the collection, and the model this PR's MTEB test uses), or of `nvidia/Nemotron-3.5-Rerank-8B-BF16`, released yesterday in Sentence Transformers format (`Transformer` + `Pooling` + `Dense`, so not this PR's code path)?

The `rerank-1b-v2` entry predates this PR and still needs its template. I'd keep both, but if you'd rather CI only runs Sentence Transformers v5.4 models, I can drop the `rerank-1b-v2` entry. Let me know.

@@ -466,6 +466,31 @@ This approach is more robust than index-based access (`messages[0]`, `messages[1
 
 Example template file: [examples/pooling/score/template/nemotron-rerank.jinja](../../../examples/pooling/score/template/nemotron-rerank.jinja)
 
+#### Templates declared by Sentence Transformers checkpoints
+
+vLLM does not apply a checkpoint's chat template by default, since many rerankers inherit an unrelated template from their base LLM. The exception is a Sentence Transformers (v5.4+) `CrossEncoder` with a single `sequence-classification` Transformer module whose `sentence_bert_config.json` declares the `message` modality. Sentence Transformers formats the pairs of such checkpoints as `query`/`document` messages, so vLLM does the same with the saved template:
+
+```json
+{
+    "transformer_task": "sequence-classification",
+    "modality_config": {
+        "text": {"method": "forward", "method_output_name": "logits"},
+        "message": {"method": "forward", "method_output_name": "logits", "format": "flat"}
+    },
+    "module_output_name": "scores",
+    "processing_kwargs": {"chat_template": {"add_generation_prompt": true}}
+}
+```
+
+- The default chat template is used, unless `processing_kwargs.chat_template.chat_template` names another template saved with the tokenizer (e.g. `additional_chat_templates/score.jinja` for `"score"`).
+- The other `processing_kwargs.chat_template` settings, such as `add_generation_prompt`, are passed to the template; the request's `chat_template_kwargs` override them.
+- Message contents are passed as strings, as with `--chat-template`.
+- vLLM does not restore the template suffix after truncation (`restore_suffix`). Use `max_tokens_per_doc` rather than `truncate_prompt_tokens` to truncate long documents.
+- `--chat-template` (or the `chat_template` argument of `LLM.score`) takes precedence over the saved template and its settings.
+- Models with a built-in score template keep using it.
+
+The template in use is logged at startup.
+
 ### Enable/disable activation
 
 You can enable or disable activation via `use_activation` only works for cross-encoder models.

+@cache
+def get_sentence_transformers_chat_template_kwargs(
+    model: str | Path,
+    revision: str | None = None,
+) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+    """Get the saved chat template settings of a Sentence Transformers
+    CrossEncoder whose single Transformer module declares the `message`
+    modality.
+
+    Sentence Transformers formats the pairs of such checkpoints as
+    `query`/`document` messages with the saved chat template.
+
+    Args:
+        model: Local checkpoint path or Hugging Face model ID.
+        revision: Model revision to inspect.
+
+    Returns:
+        The saved `processing_kwargs.chat_template` (possibly empty), or
+        `None` if the checkpoint does not declare the `message` modality.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If the saved chat template settings are unsupported.
+
+    """
+    try:
+        st_config = get_hf_file_to_dict(
+            "config_sentence_transformers.json", model, revision
+        )
+        if not isinstance(st_config, dict) or (
+            st_config.get("model_type") != "CrossEncoder"
+        ):
+            return None
+        modules = get_hf_file_to_dict("modules.json", model, revision)
+        transformer_config = get_hf_file_to_dict(
+            "sentence_bert_config.json", model, revision
+        )
+    except Exception:
+        logger.debug("Failed to read the Sentence Transformers config", exc_info=True)
+        return None
+
+    if isinstance(modules, dict):
+        modules = modules.get("modules")
+    if not (
+        isinstance(modules, list)
+        and len(modules) == 1
+        and isinstance(modules[0], dict)
+        and modules[0].get("type") in _ST_TRANSFORMER_MODULE_TYPES
+        and not modules[0].get("path")
+        and isinstance(transformer_config, dict)
+        and transformer_config.get("transformer_task") == "sequence-classification"
+        and isinstance(
+            modality_config := transformer_config.get("modality_config"), dict
+        )
+        and "message" in modality_config
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    processing_kwargs = transformer_config.get("processing_kwargs") or {}
+    chat_template_kwargs = (
+        processing_kwargs.get("chat_template") or {}
+        if isinstance(processing_kwargs, dict)
+        else None
+    )
+    if not isinstance(chat_template_kwargs, dict):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "The Sentence Transformers processing_kwargs.chat_template must be "
+            "a JSON object."
+        )
+    chat_template_kwargs = dict(chat_template_kwargs)
+    # vLLM does not restore the template suffix after truncation.
+    chat_template_kwargs.pop("restore_suffix", None)
+    if not isinstance(chat_template_kwargs.get("chat_template", ""), str):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "The Sentence Transformers chat template name must be a string."
+        )
+    if reserved := {"tokenize", "tools"} & chat_template_kwargs.keys():
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Unsupported Sentence Transformers chat template settings: {reserved}"
+        )
+    return chat_template_kwargs
+
